question: Find the paper on poly-TPD doped PTAA hole-transport layers in the literature collection and report its DOI and the control and optimised PCE. Then use the ML model to predict the PCE of a p-i-n cell with PTAA HTL, PCBM ETL and MAPbI3 (450 nm).
final_answer:
Based on the literature collection, the paper on poly-TPD doped PTAA hole-transport layers is titled *"Efficient Perovskite Solar Cells by Doping Poly-TPD into PTAA as Hole Transporting Layer"* (DOI: `10.1117/12.2506443`). 
- **Control and optimised PCE:** The paper reports that the optimised power conversion efficiency (PCE) obtained over 20% enhancement compared to the control devices with bare PTAA, with "the best PCE reaches 14.6%". Verbatim quote from the abstract: *"By doping poly-TPD into PTAA, the devices with mixed HTL show significantly enhancement of short-circuit current and fill factor, with an optimized power conversion efficiency (PCE) obtained over 20% enhancement compared with the control devices with bare PTAA, and the best PCE reaches 14.6%."*

Using the ML model, the predicted PCE for a p-i-n perovskite solar cell with a PTAA hole-transport layer, PCBM electron-transport layer, and a 450 nm MAPbI3 absorber layer is **13.46%** (with a 95% confidence interval of **[12.7, 14.66]%**).
